lobby.invite: 📲 Everyone plays on their OWN phone: tap Invite in the top bar, send the link, and friends appear here as they open it.
scores.title: Scores
setup.title: Somebody here is a spy 👀
setup.intro: Everyone learns the secret place — except the spy. Take turns asking each other questions about it. Too vague? Suspicious. Too specific? You just told the spy. 3+ players.
setup.lobbyText: Tap Invite in the top bar. Each phone peeks its own place (or learns it is the spy). No passing.
secret.spy:
🕶 YOU ARE THE SPY
Figure out where everyone is!
play.title: Interrogate each other
play.body: {name} asks first. Answer, then YOU ask someone else. Phones down — except to peek at the place list.
play.surrender: 🕶 The spy surrenders & guesses the place
places.title: All possible places
accuse.body: Who does the group accuse? Tap them:
result.caught: ✅ Got 'em! {spy} was the spy at the {place}.
result.innocent: 😱 {name} was innocent! The spy was {spy} — spy +2.
result.spyWrong: ❌ Wrong! It was the {place}. Everyone else +1.
guess.title: Spy — where is everyone?
play.bodyShort: {name} asks first. Answer, then YOU ask someone else.
play.know: I think I know the place
vote.title: 🫵 Who is the spy?
vote.hidden: Votes stay hidden until everyone's in ({have}/{total}).
guess.spyBody: Tap your guess. Wrong, and everyone else scores.
